reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Good goal, and the lower back usually lags behind the rest of the posterior chain. Build it with a hinge movement you can load progressively, like Romanian deadlifts or good mornings, plus some back extension work for endurance. Keep most of your hard sets in the 5 to 8 rep range and leave a couple of reps in the tank. If you tell me how many days you train and how long each session runs, I can build that into a full program with the lower back work in it."}
